description: Block one tool call until the Wake delivers a bounded event or timeoutSeconds elapses (1-30, default 10). Adapter-side poll loop with 1s, 2s, then 5s backoff: holds no server request open, then takes (acks) the delivered event. Taking consumes the event when the watch is consume:true; otherwise the next wait redelivers until taken. Returns a tiny event reference (type + resource + why + next), never a content dump, or triggered false with the watch status when nothing lands (including terminal consumed/cancelled watches). Fetch the resource via the existing surface, then wake_cancel when done waiting.

wakeId.description: Watch id returned by the wake tool.

name: wake_wait
